verdicts.why: Fandom's Rocket and Drax pages: on the Benatar after Thor is brought aboard, Drax and Rocket talk about Quill's weight gain.
F.R.I.D.A.Y. quote page: Tony orders her to evac south of 43rd Street, she announces Pepper's call and says 'Boss, we're losing her' as he leaves Earth.
Groot quote page: Quill tells Groot to put his game away, Groot swears, and the crew including Gamora reacts ('Language!').
Mantis goes with Quill, Gamora and Drax to Knowhere; Thanos takes Gamora and uses the Reality Stone to take out Drax and Mantis.
Gamora quote page: 'Why are we doing this again?' / 'It's a distress signal, Rocket. Someone could be dying.' The call leads to Thor.
Groot quote page: 'Groot, put that thing away, now...' / 'I am Groot.' followed by the crew's shocked reaction.
Compound: Ross orders the arrivals including Romanoff arrested and Rhodes cuts the transmission; both then fight in the Battle of Wakanda.
Same compound scene with Wilson among the arrivals; Rhodes cuts Ross off and both defend Wakanda.
Vision is brought to the compound where Rhodes cuts Ross off; Rhodes is among the defenders buying Shuri time to extract the Stone.
M'Baku quote page: 'This will be the end of Wakanda.' / 'Then it will be the noblest ending in history.' (M'Baku and Okoye), then the battle.
M'Baku page: notified by T'Challa, he brings the Jabari, is thanked for coming by T'Challa and goes into battle beside him.
Nebula messages Mantis to meet her on Titan; on Titan Mantis holds Thanos under, says he mourns, and Nebula realizes he killed Gamora.
Mantis page: aboard the Benatar the team rescues Thor; Rocket and Groot go with Thor and Mantis waves them goodbye as the pod departs.

value.title: Avengers: Infinity War
value.text: Hill is with Fury on a city street when people start turning to dust, and she fades away in front of him just before he sends a last signal.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Hill's boss and friend, who watches her turn to dust.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Fury's right hand, who turns to dust in front of him.

verdicts.why: The post-credits scene is not set in New York (Hill reports energy signatures like New York's, and the MCU wiki places the drive in Atlanta); the rest is correct, so the location is dropped.
Rogers, Romanoff and Wilson rescue Wanda and Vision in Edinburgh, go to the compound, then lead the defense in Wakanda.
Ross confronts the fugitives including Romanoff by hologram ('You got some nerve' / 'You could use some of that right now') and orders their arrest; Rhodes cuts him off.
On the Midtown field trip bus Ned distracts the class so Peter can slip away and suit up.
Okoye page: Okoye watches in the medical center as Shuri explains removing the Mind Stone, then gets the alert about craft entering the atmosphere. A scene together; text and cards are accurate.
T'Challa and Okoye fight together in Wakanda; after the Snap he reaches to help her up ('Up, General!') and turns to dust.
The Guardians rescue Thor; Rocket and Groot go with Thor to Nidavellir while Quill leads the rest to Knowhere.
Rogers, Romanoff and Wilson rescue Wanda and Vision in Edinburgh, then defend Wakanda under Rogers.
Ross confronts the fugitives including Wilson at the compound by hologram and orders their arrest; Rhodes cuts him off.
Midnight and Glaive ambush Wanda and Vision in Edinburgh; Rogers, Romanoff and Wilson rescue them and they fight together in Wakanda.
Banner crashes into the Sanctum and warns Strange and Wong; they fight Maw and Obsidian, Maw captures Strange and Wong stays to guard the Sanctum.
Wikiquote: Rogers to Ross, 'I'm not looking for forgiveness, and I'm way past asking for permission'; Ross orders the arrest and Rhodes cuts him off.
Wikiquote: 'New haircut?' / 'Notice you've copied my beard.' as Thor arrives in Wakanda with Rocket and Groot.
Rogers leads the Edinburgh rescue of Wanda and Vision and proposes Wakanda to remove the Stone without killing Vision.
Rogers, Wilson, Romanoff, Vision and Maximoff arrive at the compound and Ross demands they all be arrested before Rhodes cuts him off.

They never meet, speak or call each other in this film; Tony only mentions Steve and carries his phone, and it is Bruce who calls Steve. Under the owner's rule a mention with no exchange is not a stage.
Mantis and Groot are aboard the Benatar for the rescue of Thor; Groot leaves with Rocket and Thor while Mantis goes to Knowhere.
List page: List tells Strucker to send out the twins, Strucker says it is too soon, then tells List he will surrender.
Nick Fury page: Fury waits at the Barton homestead, rallies the team, and Banner works out Ultron will force Helen Cho to build him a new body.
The Avengers fight among themselves over Stark and Banner's decision to upload J.A.R.V.I.S. into the synthetic body, with Rogers trying to stop it.

value.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
value.text: Thor's lightning brings to life the synthetic body Bruce and Tony have loaded J.A.R.V.I.S. into, and the being that wakes is the Vision.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Avenger whose lightning wakes the body Bruce worked on.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Avenger who works on the body Thor's lightning brings to life.

verdicts.why: They do deal with each other here, but Bruce and Tony did not build the body: Ultron made it with Cho's cradle, and they uploaded J.A.R.V.I.S. into it before Thor activates it.
Maria Hill page: after Johannesburg Hill calls Barton while he pilots the Quinjet and recommends a hideout; he says he knows where to go and takes them to his home.
